items.description:
• Altán MVNO (Macropay SIM): Optimized system performance via a caching layer with Amazon ElastiCache (Redis). Designed a validation flow prioritizing Redis queries before external requests to Altán, reducing latency and load on provider APIs.
• Provider Management (Jobs): Developed scheduled processes and middlewares in NestJS via Docker on AWS to automate lock, unlock, and enrollment operations with 3 providers. Implemented real-time data synchronization with SQL Server.
• Belvo Integration: Integrated Belvo API as an aggregator to automate fetching official entity information. Developed institutional data extraction and processing flows for financial risk evaluation and profile validation.
• Financing Cancellation Engine: Refactored an API and Cronjob for automated cancellation of abandoned user credits. Implemented Prisma ORM to optimize data access, improving type safety and DB efficiency.
• Travel Portal | Macropay: Developed integration between the portal and SAP using OData services. Designed an adaptation layer to synchronize critical business processes, allowing real-time data interoperability with the ERP ecosystem.

• CRM Evolution and Development: Executed visual and functional updates on existing CRM modules (CakePHP), improving navigation and UX. Refactored components by eliminating obsolete functions to optimize internal processes.
• Database Logic: Designed and implemented Stored Procedures (SP) and Views in MySQL to centralize complex query logic, ensuring data integrity and optimizing CRM response times.
• Landing Pages Optimization (Angular): Managed continuous improvements on multiple Angular-based landing pages for real estate projects. Implemented component-based sections and optimized load performance to maximize lead generation.

• Payment Gateways: Implemented credit card processing solutions by integrating Rapipago API and connecting Getnet terminals for customer-facing systems.
• Ovalo24: Developed a custom software solution with real-time bidirectional synchronization via APIs, ensuring seamless data flow between the local system and the company's web portal.
• Hybrid Connectivity (Web/Desktop): Developed cross-platform connections between web and desktop applications using JavaScript and PHP, managing the Velneo development environment for desktop solutions.

• API Development and Connectivity: Developed new features and optimized existing APIs using Laravel and Node.js to manage critical company connections and ensure interoperability between systems.
• E-commerce and CMS Management: Maintained and updated web applications using PHP Laravel and MySQL. Modified PrestaShop environments, implementing complex business logic and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
Completed degree in Computer Systems Engineering.
